//@version=6
indicator("V52 format-union-enum", calc_bars_count=32)
enum ReviewEnum
    one = "One"
value = str.format("{0}", ReviewEnum.one)
plot(bar_index, "SOURCE_INDEX")
plot(str.length(value), "RESULT_LENGTH")
plot(na(value) ? 1 : 0, "RESULT_NA")
if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory
    log.info("RESULT=[{0}]", value)
    label.new(bar_index, high, text=value)
